description: Source code for a Lighttpd module 'mod_setenv' that manages setting request/response headers and environment variables.

methods.name: handler_ctx_init
methods.description: Initializes a handler context with allocated memory.

methods.name: handler_ctx_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a handler context.

methods.name: mod_setenv_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges a single configuration plugin value into plugin_config.

methods.name: mod_setenv_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration plugin values into plugin_config.

methods.name: mod_setenv_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration patches to request based on current context.

methods.name: mod_setenv_prep_ext
methods.description: Prepares header extension keys and sanitizes header values.

methods.name: mod_setenv_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the module.

methods.name: mod_setenv_uri_handler
methods.description: Handles URI requests, setting request headers as configured.

methods.name: mod_setenv_handle_request_env
methods.description: Handles setting environment variables for the request.

methods.name: mod_setenv_handle_response_start
methods.description: Handles setting response headers at the start of response.

methods.name: mod_setenv_handle_request_reset
methods.description: Resets the handler context for a new request.

methods.name: mod_setenv_plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting function pointers and metadata.
